q1_issues.issue: "the Texas coast" is encoded as (PartOf sk_coast_1 texas), but the instruction set states that a place inside a place is LocatedIn and never PartOf, whose two jobs are object-component and group-membership.

q2_gaps: a relative-time adjunct "later in the day": neither a calendar/clock structured term nor one of the listed speech-anchored deictics, so the instruction set supplies no form (the parse mints the ad-hoc constant later_in_the_day)
notes: The rest tracks the instruction set: name + kind atom for the organization, non-factive seal of the whole report with the definite hurricane/coast typing projected, Past+Ongoing for "was heading", Might for "could", Goal for the whither-PP, and Before in earlier-then-later order. Two judgment calls worth noting: Patient for the hurricane's motion (the non-volitional natural-force clause) and no Future on "hits", where "later in the day" arguably counts as the lexically future adjunct the futurate rule wants.
